description: Format a source-neutral software release name, build identifier, and optional pre-rendered icon.
documentation_wikitext:
__NOTOC__
Format a source-neutral software release name, build identifier, and optional pre-rendered icon.

== Usage ==
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">
{{Version label|name=Example|build=123|icon_content={{Abbr|V|Version}}}}
</syntaxhighlight>

Omit optional parameters that do not apply. The parameter reference below lists supported names and aliases.

examples.description: A named software release with an exact build.

implementation.body_wikitext: {{#if:{{{icon_content|}}}|{{{icon_content}}} }}{{#if:{{{name|}}}|{{{name}}}{{#if:{{{build|}}}| ({{{build}}})}}|{{#if:{{{build|}}}|{{{build}}}|Error: version name or build required}}}}

parameters.description: Optional pre-rendered icon content, such as Template:Preservation image.
parameters.label: Icon content
parameters.name: icon_content
